text: Perfect

Product was deliver in a timely manner.  The product worked as good as the compatible Whirlpool filter for my refrigerator, but at a fraction of the cost.  The Whirlpool filter was almost $40, while this filter was around $8.

I noticed that several comments noted the different angle the handle makes when the filter is installed.  Our new filter did the same thing, but it's seated, working fine, and doesn't seem to be leaking; it must have the threads started in a different place on the filter.  So far, so good.

I learned after trying to force fit it , and a call to the repairman, that it is not compatible.  After it didn't work, I compared the insertion end fitting with the Whirlpool OEM, and found that they were different.  So, my advice if you buy a generic substitute is to first  look at the insertion end of the filter, and be sure that the fitting is exactly the same configuration and dimensions.  If not, do not try to force fit as you may end like me with an unnecessary repair bill.

This is my second order of this filter and couldn't be happier. The performance is on par, if not better than other  more expensive filters I used to buy here. This is an amazing deal. I have had zero issues with water leaking. I gently give it a nice tightening  with channel locks just in case. The taste of our water remains the same as with the more expensive Sears brand or the higher priced ones here on Amazon. I live in NYC, so we do have some of the greatest tasting water to begin with. This filter does a very fine job at removing chlorine and possibly other harmful elements and I really can't taste any traces of it. Perhaps the most amazing aspect is the water flow of this budget filer. It is pretty strong and it can sustain such for several months, unlike the more expensive alternatives I've used in the past.

I might forgive the poor fit, except without the filter completely engaged, sometimes the filter pops out and water sprays onto the floor! Fortunately while I was able to turn off the water before anything was damaged.

I sent a query to the supplier, and was sent instructions for installing the filter. (but there was nothing that I didn't already know) I also asked the supplier if they offer a filter that replaces Kenmore 9915, and I have not received a response.

If anyone has found a good replacement for Kenmore 9915, please let me know!

Update to the review:
To diagnose the problem I purchased a genuine Kenmore 9915 from another source, and I examined the differences. With some work I am able to use the generic filter.
